# Next Tab Agency

> Next Tab Agency is a Brisbane-based digital marketing and web development agency founded in 2019 by Hamza Ishfaq. The agency operates with 20 in-house specialists — zero outsourcing — and serves Australian businesses across SEO, Paid Advertising, Web Development, and Mobile Apps. Headquarters: Taylor Street, Eagleby, QLD 4207. Phone: 0491 000 094. Email: info@nexttabagency.com. Website: https://nexttabagency.com

Next Tab Agency's core philosophy is to deliver digital ecosystems that act as revenue engines, not generic packages. Key differentiators include the proprietary Antigravity Framework (sub-1s Core Web Vitals), month-to-month contracts with no lock-in, and a no-backlink ranking strategy for qualifying clients using topical authority and entity SEO. All services are delivered by Brisbane-based in-house specialists.

The agency serves Australian businesses nationally, with a primary focus on Brisbane, Queensland, and South-East QLD (Gold Coast, Sunshine Coast, Logan, Ipswich). Remote services cover Sydney, Melbourne, Perth, Adelaide, Canberra, and Hobart.

Trust signals: 4.9/5 average rating across 200+ Australian clients. 70%+ month-to-month retention. Google Ads and GA4 certified practitioners. Founded 2019 — 7 years in the Australian digital market.
